decisions.reason: After four years and two years without website visibility, the niche citrus harvesting crate no longer offers enough unresolved upside to justify keeping this specialized option open despite its original flagship status.
A stackable plastic crate line remains very close to the firm's core reusable-packaging business, so it is still worth keeping as a relatively low-cost option even with limited recent visibility.
The medium-duty rackable pallet fits the established pallet portfolio and customer base, making the cost of retention low enough that management would likely continue to hold the option open.
The spill-retention pallet is a narrower adjacent application and, after several years without visible evidence of traction, its option value appears too limited relative to better uses of resources.
This pallet variant looks more specialized than the core lines, and the lack of continued prominence suggests its market potential has been sufficiently revealed to favor withdrawal.
